source: War Caster

You have advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration, you can cast with somatic components while holding weapons or a shield, and you can cast a one-action spell targeting one creature as an opportunity attack.
Weapon Master
Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
Fey Touched

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn misty step and one 1st-level divination or enchantment spell, each castable once per long rest without a slot as well as with slots.
Shadow Touched

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn invisibility and one 1st-level illusion or necromancy spell, each castable once per long rest without a slot as well as with slots.
Telekinetic

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You learn mage hand and can cast it without components at 30 extra feet, and as a bonus action you can shove a creature within 30 feet 5 feet on a failed Strength save.
Telepathic

Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can speak telepathically to any creature within 60 feet that shares a language with you, and you can cast detect thoughts once per long rest without a slot.
Eldritch Adept
You learn one Eldritch Invocation of your choice whose prerequisites you meet. You can replace it when you gain a level.
Metamagic Adept
You learn two Metamagic options from the sorcerer list and gain 2 sorcery points to spend on them, refilled on a long rest.
Skill Expert
Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency in one skill, and expertise in one skill you are already proficient in.
Chef

Increase your Constitution or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20, and gain proficiency with cook's utensils. Cooking during a short rest lets allies regain an extra 1d8 hit points, and an hour's work makes treats that grant temporary hit points.
Crusher

Increase your Strength or Constitution by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal bludgeoning damage you can move the creature 5 feet, and a critical hit with bludgeoning damage gives attackers advantage against it until your next turn.
Piercer

Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal piercing damage you can reroll one damage die, and a critical hit with piercing damage adds one extra damage die.
Slasher

Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. Once per turn when you deal slashing damage you can reduce the target's speed by 10 feet, and a critical hit with slashing damage gives it disadvantage on attack rolls until your next turn.
Poisoner

You ignore resistance to poison damage, you can coat a weapon as a bonus action so its next hit forces a DC 14 Constitution save for 2d8 poison damage and the poisoned condition, and you gain proficiency with the poisoner's kit.
Gunner

Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency with firearms, ignore their loading property, and being within 5 feet of a hostile creature gives you no disadvantage on ranged attacks.
Alert

Your guard never quite drops. Add 5 to every initiative roll you make. While you are conscious no ambush catches you off guard, and an attacker hidden from your sight gets no advantage against you merely because you cannot see it.
Skilled
Pick any three skills or tools, in any combination, and gain proficiency with each. This feat raises no ability score.
Savage Attacker
Once on each of your turns, when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can roll the weapon's damage dice a second time and keep whichever total you like.
Blade Ward
You trace a warding sigil. Until the end of your next turn, bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from weapon attacks is halved against you.
Booming Blade

Make a melee attack with the weapon you cast this through, against a creature within 5 feet. A hit deals the weapon's normal damage and wraps the target in booming energy until your next turn starts. Should the target move 5 feet or more of its own accord first, the energy discharges for 1d8 thunder damage and the spell ends.
Control Flames
You take control of a nonmagical flame within range that fills a 5-foot cube. You can expand it, extinguish it, double or halve its light, or make it form simple shapes and animations for an hour.
